changelog: - **The uptime job now notices when a marketing host shows the wrong product, and its outage alert can fire again** (#2579). `/api/health` answers the same JSON on every host a container serves, so `uptime.yml` stayed green while `marketing.bcsit-gmbh.de` served the internship landing (the #2428 failure). Every run now also reads `/` and `/imprint` on `marketing.bcsit-gmbh.de` and `.dev`: the `<title>` must name SaleVali and must not say "Internship CRM". The rule is `scripts/marketing-content-probe.mjs` (dependency-free, fetched with a one-file sparse checkout, so the green path still skips `npm ci`); `scripts/test/marketing-content-probe.test.mjs` runs the real CLI against a local server and proves that a wrong title exits 1 with a one-line finding and that green prints nothing. Findings are retried once like the reachability probe and open their **own** incident — a separate `uptime-content-alert` issue + mail ("Marketing host yanlış ürünü gösteriyor"), never the outage's `uptime-alert` one, so a content incident left open for days cannot mask a later outage (and the reverse); a content finding on a host whose `/api/health` is already down is left to the outage alert. The probe's one-file checkout is `continue-on-error` and the workflow now grants `contents: read`, so a failed fetch can never skip the reachability probe. While testing this, the probe step turned out to write `…-> 000EOF` into `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` on a real outage (`$(probe_all)` strips the trailing newline, so the heredoc's closing `EOF` was never on its own line) — the runner rejects that file, so on `main` no incident issue or mail could ever be sent; the newline is now restored. `infra/deploy-prod.sh` runs the same title check on every fresh replica after the swap, **warn-only** (curl + sed, no Node on the box; `MARKETING_PROBE=0` skips it); the host it asks for is named by the caller (`MARKETING_PROBE_HOST` in `deploy-prod.yml` / `deploy-preview.yml`), not read from the `MARKETING_HOSTS` it validates, and it also warns when that host is missing from the effective `MARKETING_HOSTS` set. `infra/README.md` § The marketing hosts gains an operator checklist for the parts of #2579 that need prod access (MARKETING org + trial stages, host→org mapping, the retired-name 308).
